summary: SKK Holdings filed a 6-K updating its acquisition of substantially all drone-based technology assets from Rantizo, Inc. under a May 1, 2026 APA. Consideration comprises $759,047 cash plus roughly $258.8 million in newly issued Class A shares priced off the three-day VWAP; an added $10 million escrowed Rantizo private placement converts into further shares, totaling about 61,236,902 shares at a $4.39 assumed VWAP. Shareholders approved on June 22, 2026, along with a name change to Rantizo. Newbridge Securities provided an independent valuation; Rantizo gains two board seats and Marianne McInerney becomes President post-closing. Watch VWAP-driven share-count dilution and resale registration overhang.
